text:
Lena (partnerships): Heads up 101010 we've started seeing overlapping claims across SI-sourced marketplace referrals + HW partner leads. Need a clear stewarding and escalation flow that covers: canonical account mapping, intake tags, claim windows, and revenue attribution. Propose a 72h SI-intro window, with automatic co-own if AE and SI both log activity within that window. Inputs?

Hugo (AE): 72h seems generous but OK. Two asks: 1) What counts as \"logged activity\"? Meetings, emails logged in CRM, demo invites? 2) Can RevOps see the raw attribution timeline?

Tara (partner-ops): For intake we'll require canonical_account_id (from account-mapper), source_detail (marketplace|hardware|SI), partner_ref_id, and intro_evidence (timestamp + type). partner-ops will block auto-assign if intro_evidence missing.

Miguel (si-ops): From SI side: we sometimes bring hardware vendor in later. Suggest rule: if SI submits intro_evidence (email/snippet) before any AE touch -> SI gets initial credit for pipeline stage (intro). If AE later converts, mark as co-owned. Also want automatic labeling for HW-referred deals so hardware partner SKUs can be tracked.

Aisha (legal): Please ensure partner-level exceptions are surfaced (some contracts give exclusive crediting for marketplace referrals). Also PII checks: if lead content includes contact-level PII flagged by DPA, partner-ops must hold and get consent before routing.

Claire (revops): We need a reproducible revenue attribution event log. Suggest these discrete events: intro_submitted, first_touch_crm, demo_completed, opp_created, booked. Each event should carry actor_type (SI|AE|HW), partner_id, canonical_account_id. RevOps will compute attribution using rule-set, but ops needs to store raw events.

Lena (partnerships): Agree. Quick draft rules I'm proposing now:
1) Intake: all partner leads must include canonical_account_id and source_detail. Missing canonical_account_id -> route to \"account-validation\" queue.
2) SI intro window = 72 hours from intro_evidence timestamp. If SI submits intro_evidence and no AE first_touch event exists in CRM within 72h -> assign steward=SI and tag=si_intro.
3) AE priority override: if AE has existing stewardship on canonical_account_id (owner in CRM) OR ACV_history > 50k in last 12 months -> AE retains priority even if SI intro is within 72h.
4) Co-ownership: if both AE.first_touch and SI.intro_evidence exist within 72h -> mark = co_owned. Default rev split 60/40 (AE/SI) pending contract exceptions.
5) Marketplace referrals and HW referrals use same intake but add referral_channel tag and sku_id list for tracking.
6) Exceptions: any partner.metadata.flag(contract_override|exclusive_credit) -> follow contract field.

Hugo (AE): That AE priority threshold (50k) makes sense. Can we lower to 30k for certain verticals?

Lena (partnerships): We'll have partner metadata \"acv_override_thresholds\" per vertical. Partner-ops to expose.

Tara (partner-ops): Implementation note: we'll post a Slack message to #partners-intake when a conflicting assignment occurs. Workflow: reaction :white_check_mark: = I accept stewardship (must be done within 24h), :question: = request manual adjudication. If no reaction within 24h, follow the deterministic rule above.

infra-bot: routing-service: rule \"si_marketplace_intro_window\" = 72h created in staging. audit-log id=route-7182.

Miguel (si-ops): Nice. For HW partners we need to capture referral_sku and referral_invoice_prefix so RevOps can link rebates.

Claire (revops): We'll consume referral_sku/referral_invoice_prefix for rebate calculations. Also please make sure the event payload includes opportunity_stage and ARR_estimate.

Aisha (legal): For co-owned deals ensure we attach partner contract id to opportunity. RevOps should refuse to allocate revenue until contract check passes.

Hugo (AE): One practical item: sometimes AEs start a discovery call before logging first_touch in CRM. Can we allow quick log via Slack shortcut that creates first_touch event?

Tara (partner-ops): Yes. We'll add a lightweight Slack slash action (/partner-touch lead_id note) that creates first_touch event and notifies #partners-intake.

Lena (partnerships): Pilot plan: enable this flow for two SIs + marketplace referrals in the EU region for 3 weeks. Partner-ops to run daily dedupe reports and RevOps to validate attribution. Success metrics: dedupe rate <3%, mean resolution time <36h for contests, and correct rebate tagging on 100% of HW referral ops.

Miguel (si-ops): We'll prepare onboarding doc for SIs and sample email templates for intro evidence.

Claire (revops): I'll prepare a sample attribution report and a test dataset.

Aisha (legal): I'll scan sample contracts for exclusivity and send a list of exceptions to partner-ops.

Lena (partnerships): Thanks team. I'll circulate the short SOP and the JSON schema for intake by EOD tomorrow. If no major objections, we'll flip staging rules Thursday.

Hugo (AE): Thanks 3ff5410 this should reduce friction.

Lena (partnerships): tagging @here for visibility.
